{"lines":[{"lineId":"350","lineNum":358,"lineType":1,"content":"一太陽照妻宫，孤立者皆主夫妻年紀不等，否則妨尅","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887413311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017722450395174"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":362,"lineType":1,"content":"重婚。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887413311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"353","lineNum":364,"lineType":1,"content":"一、太隂正照妻宫，皆主妻妾無貌，不然亦非正禮而婚，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887429695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":366,"lineType":1,"content":"縁太隂有盈𧇊之不常也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887429695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"355","lineNum":368,"lineType":1,"content":"一、太乙抱蟾，常人見孛與月同行，便謂之太乙抱蟾，非","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887446079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887446079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":370,"lineType":1,"content":"須是上弦及望前，既望下弦在未上見之，及生於戌","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887462463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"亥子丑夜生者，方合此格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887462463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":372,"lineType":1,"content":"如非其地，又非其時，名為抱","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887478847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":374,"lineType":1,"content":"死鬼，却不能為福矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887478847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"361","lineNum":376,"lineType":1,"content":"一、木羅㑹舍，必在寅上為吉，葢木喜羅樂之地，二星相","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887495231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017744348741666"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":380,"lineType":1,"content":"得為㑹舍，在他宫則亂格，不足為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887495231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":382,"lineType":1,"content":"一、火炁為職權，在寅夘為大吉，葢火廟於夘，生於寅，寅","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887511615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":384,"lineType":1,"content":"為炁之垣，夘為炁之旺地，二星相得，故為職權，不以晝","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887511615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":386,"lineType":1,"content":"夜為拘，其他福必减半。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887511615","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":388,"lineType":1,"content":"一、木孛為符印，在未為得局，盖木升殿於未，孛入廟於","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887527999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":390,"lineType":1,"content":"未，二星得所方吉，他宫其福减半。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887527999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"369","lineNum":392,"lineType":1,"content":"一、火羅孛計乃四凶曜，化凶化吉，並宜獨行，則主重權。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887544383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":394,"lineType":1,"content":"一、土星為災至緩，主病淹滯難瘥，使人晦懶，作事有頭","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887560767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017746496307236"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"372","lineNum":398,"lineType":1,"content":"無尾，或出一月，其病方發。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887560767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"373","lineNum":400,"lineType":1,"content":"一紫氣為灾，比星尤緩。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887577151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":402,"lineType":1,"content":"一金星，不要坐羊刃的刼煞之上，葢金主殺，遇煞則煞","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887593535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":404,"lineType":1,"content":"氣輝騰，故為煞至重。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887593535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":406,"lineType":1,"content":"一、計羅截斷之格，不宜太陽跳出，犯此名為孤君逺遁，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887609919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"君主無輔，極為不美。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887609919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":408,"lineType":1,"content":"葢太陽乃君𧰼，只欲五曜輔佐，吉","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887626303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"星拱夾，方為吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887626303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":410,"lineType":1,"content":"若孤立於外，主人一生奔波，不得人","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887642687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":412,"lineType":1,"content":"力，雖我附人，人多逺之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887642687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017685280374825"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":416,"lineType":1,"content":"一、羅計截㫁半天星，此格有吉有凶，或截在左，行限在","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887659071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":418,"lineType":1,"content":"右，或截在右，行限在左，名曰反背為限度，不與諸星㑹","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887659071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"遇故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887659071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":420,"lineType":1,"content":"又有升沉之不同，或日生而諸曜當天，截在邜","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887675455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":422,"lineType":1,"content":"辰已午未申位，而有星，行限却從酉戌，灾子丑寅位而","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887675455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"無星者，為不得體。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887675455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":424,"lineType":1,"content":"或夜生人截斷諸星在酉戌亥子丑","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887691839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":426,"lineType":1,"content":"寅位，行限又從邜辰已午未申位無星之地，皆為升沉","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887691839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"不同，並不合格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887691839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"此格當專論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887708223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":428,"lineType":1,"content":"一星跳出在外者何如，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887724607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":430,"lineType":1,"content":"或為福星、禄星、財星、命主，或官星、權星、貴星、爵星、夀星，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887724607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017759737675816"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"夜火夜月，晝木晝土，皆為得格，主人必有富貴福夀。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887724607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":434,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887740991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":436,"lineType":1,"content":"跳出一星，或是刑囚暗耗，或奴僕主、羊刃主、刼煞主、的","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887740991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":438,"lineType":1,"content":"煞主，晝生而有漏出，或火漏出，或夜生而日裏星辰漏","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887740991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":440,"lineType":1,"content":"出者，皆不合格，主人貧苦勞碌，處世無成，皆不可為吉","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887740991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":442,"lineType":1,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887740991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"402","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"一、太隂逐月隨日而化，金、木、水、火、土。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887757375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":444,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂屬水，則不喜","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887773759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":446,"lineType":1,"content":"土月同𨇠，如太隂屬木，則不喜金月同𨇠，餘可例推，犯","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887773759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":448,"lineType":1,"content":"之皆帶疾妨尅，如更在空亡亡神、刼煞空亡之鄉者，决主","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887773759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017746496323620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":452,"lineType":1,"content":"其人亂説是非，言語不定。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887773759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"408","lineNum":454,"lineType":1,"content":"一、令星在太陽之前，名為旺進，若是命主在前為持進，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887790143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"名曰令星拱日，又曰令星當衡，皆主權貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887790143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":456,"lineType":1,"content":"若命主及令","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887806527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":458,"lineType":1,"content":"星在太陽之後者，名曰後進，其福减半。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887806527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"412","lineNum":460,"lineType":1,"content":"一、諸星並行，有前有後，凡煞星則欲其前行，主星則欲","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887822911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":462,"lineType":1,"content":"其後至，且如水火同行，水尅火為煞，水在火前則為不","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887822911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"尅，火在水前則煞逼身，最為大害，不可不審。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887822911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":464,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：煞前","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887839295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"主後，當膺藩輔之權；煞後主前，必有徒流之患。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887839295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":466,"lineType":1,"content":"此之謂","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887855679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017722450444326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":470,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887855679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"一、諸星㑹聚，有吉㑹在凶㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887872063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":472,"lineType":1,"content":"吉㑹者，如命主、身主、度主、","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887888447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"官魁、福、禄、化、貴、權、印、䕃，則為吉㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887888447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":474,"lineType":1,"content":"雖是火、羅、計、孛，若作","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887904831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，亦為吉㑹。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887904831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":476,"lineType":1,"content":"若為羊、刃、刼、煞，及化、刑、囚、暗、耗，皆為凶㑹，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887921215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":478,"lineType":1,"content":"主禍。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887921215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"427","lineNum":480,"lineType":1,"content":"一、諸星並要分行，善惡不可混雜，故善者專為吉，惡者","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887937599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"專為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887937599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":482,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：善惡不宜雜處，吉凶要在分行，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887953983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":484,"lineType":1,"content":"人命中或見福禄單行為吉，若福刑相㑹，禄耗並行，吉","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887970367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017706558357541"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":488,"lineType":1,"content":"星凶星皆主利名，有成有敗，處世無成。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887970367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"一、五星退行，有退而有力者，有退而無力者。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847887986751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":490,"lineType":1,"content":"且如火金","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888003135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":492,"lineType":1,"content":"二星同行，佱在前，火在後而退，此煞星不敢進前以尅","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888003135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"金，是謂退而有力。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888003135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":494,"lineType":1,"content":"若金星退，遇火順行，反尅金星，是謂","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888019519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"退而無力。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888019519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":496,"lineType":1,"content":"余可例推。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888035903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":498,"lineType":1,"content":"一、五星退行，有退而升殿、入垣、逄生，皆為有情，反作吉","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888052287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888052287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":500,"lineType":1,"content":"或退而坐煞、逢煞，及入惡弱之宫，皆為無情，决作凶","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888068671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":502,"lineType":1,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888068671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017746496340004"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"一、退星為禍為福尤甚，葢行遲故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888085055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"446","lineNum":506,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：星躔退度，善","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888101439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":508,"lineType":1,"content":"惡分外有情，看命者審之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888101439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":510,"lineType":1,"content":"一、諸星在命，皆為所属，既能為吉，亦能為凶，其論巳載","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888117823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":512,"lineType":1,"content":"玄妙集中，細看極有靈驗。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888117823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"450","lineNum":514,"lineType":9,"content":"論十二宫守照活𠮓看法","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888134207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"一、十二宫分皆要詳看，先看其宫，後看其主。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888150591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":516,"lineType":1,"content":"凡宫為祖，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888166975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":518,"lineType":1,"content":"𧺫星為已，且如田宅宫，忌破空亡刼煞守之，若𧺫星居","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888166975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":520,"lineType":1,"content":"髙無祖，業自創成，若宫好主𧺫不好，雖有田宅而不能","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888166975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017759737692200"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"受用，革故鼎新方可。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888166975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"又看其生旺如何，定其加减。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888183359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":524,"lineType":1,"content":"若五","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888199743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"星本壞，將餘氣代用者，主屋宅不新，亦不甚髙廣。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888199743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":526,"lineType":1,"content":"如妻","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888216127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":528,"lineType":1,"content":"主壞，以四餘代用者，主無正妻，或重婚；為子主壞者，或","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888216127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"非親子。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888216127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":530,"lineType":1,"content":"又看其主，主𧺫逺近何如，如加祿貴生旺則吉，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888232511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":532,"lineType":1,"content":"推此可例餘宫。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888232511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"465","lineNum":534,"lineType":1,"content":"一、十二宫中主星雖有定位，然亦本主，考之則釣𧺫飛","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888248895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":536,"lineType":1,"content":"來，滿盤活潑潑的底，昧者弗思，捨本生而拘於星曜，乃","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888248895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":538,"lineType":1,"content":"尋日月之夾拱，福祿之貼照，官魁之引從，金水之秀麗，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888248895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017722450460710"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"木炁之慈善，凡如此𩔖，便以為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888248895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":542,"lineType":1,"content":"纔見金寅、火酉、木子、","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888265279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":544,"lineType":1,"content":"土巳、水戌，及金乘火位，火入金鄉，木到大梁，晝火夜土","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888265279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"之𩔖，例排為凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888265279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":546,"lineType":1,"content":"殊不知一宫之星，自有六七等議論，隨","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888281663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":548,"lineType":1,"content":"其所躔，斟酌重輕，品藻淺深，生成尅制，有無窮妙用，豈","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888281663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"可以一言盡，一途拘哉？","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888281663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":550,"lineType":1,"content":"葢觀星者，遇一命在目，便是一","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888298047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"公案在前，必用明斷，如快刀破竹，無纎毫礙滯。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888298047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":552,"lineType":1,"content":"若胷中","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888314431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":554,"lineType":1,"content":"無有真見，言無定力，則言凶而慮其吉，言吉而疑其凶，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888314431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"糊塗不决，皂白不分。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888314431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":556,"lineType":1,"content":"或有所學未至，妄以敢斷自許，至","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888330815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017744348839970"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"於隨指隨錯，禍福無慿也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888330815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":560,"lineType":1,"content":"必心傅有源，識見無差，議論","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888347199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":562,"lineType":1,"content":"如影響之答，一時言之而不自覺，方可為善斷也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888347199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":564,"lineType":1,"content":"一、五星隨宫用之，則隨人盤論之，亦如前法逐宫論之，","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888363583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"不可造次。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888363583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"又看其得令則有力，失令則無力。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888379967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":566,"lineType":1,"content":"又忌斷躔","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888396351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"失躔與四餘相㑹，加諸煞大凶，亦可隨煞而論之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888396351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":568,"lineType":1,"content":"又推","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888412735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":570,"lineType":1,"content":"三方對衝，相援則吉，尅則大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888412735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":572,"lineType":1,"content":"一凡論命之法，先看立命何宫何度，以宫為輕，度主為","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888429119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":574,"lineType":1,"content":"重，最怕外星來尅命者為忌，或宫主尅度者為輕，或加","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888429119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017744348872738"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星，反有名利之許。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888429119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":578,"lineType":1,"content":"又看三方對衝生尅者，亦如此論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888445503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"宫主失躔，生平减力，度主失次者，祖業難招。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888461887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":580,"lineType":1,"content":"若限強有","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888478271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"力者，主發財。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888478271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":582,"lineType":1,"content":"故曰命弱限強，如枯苗之得雨，此之謂也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888494655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":584,"lineType":1,"content":"一凡看五星之法，須是排定太陽，以生時加在太陽度","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888511039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"上，則知安命在何宫，方為端的。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888511039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":586,"lineType":1,"content":"須是以度主為要，宫主","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888527423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"次之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033847888527423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"葢宫主者，州郡也；度主者，縣令也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054677546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":588,"lineType":1,"content":"由縣而州，縣為","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054693930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"508","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"切近，二主俱要逢生旺得時為妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054693930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":590,"lineType":1,"content":"凡身主切於命主，度","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054710314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"主切於宫主。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054710314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生人重身度主，日生人重命度主。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054726698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":592,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054743082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017674794876928"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":596,"lineType":1,"content":"身好命不好，有福無夀；命好身不好，有夀無福。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054743082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":598,"lineType":1,"content":"一看命須是四正為𦂳，或曰月照四正，或金木照四正，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054759466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":600,"lineType":1,"content":"福徳照四正，及用星居四正之位，皆是貴顯受用之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054759466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"又有火羅計孛守四強，及化得好者，皆為合格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054775850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":602,"lineType":1,"content":"若是刑","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054792234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":604,"lineType":1,"content":"囚暗耗等星，居於四正宫中，而逢刑傷尅制之星，皆主","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054792234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":606,"lineType":1,"content":"破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054792234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"一看命弱暗之星，則要其居䧟弱。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054808618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":608,"lineType":1,"content":"其明顯得用之星，則","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054825002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":610,"lineType":1,"content":"欲其居髙強。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054825002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017746496372772"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":614,"lineType":1,"content":"一看命不要星辰十分顯見，如禄居禄位，福守福宫，金","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054841386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":616,"lineType":1,"content":"水夾日守命，皆大顯，名曰敷露，不能大富大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054841386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":618,"lineType":1,"content":"一看命務要求其主星命度，命主身度，身主須看強弱，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054857770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"以論禍福，不必主星一一髙強，一一得地。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054857770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":620,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：一星得","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054874154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"用，終為顯貴吉人。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054874154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":622,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：使一星背而莫救其非，縱羣曜","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054890538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"吉而莫能為福。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054890538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"又云：一星加臨，如此命永為吉慶。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054906922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":624,"lineType":1,"content":"譬如","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054923306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":626,"lineType":1,"content":"五七品官員在任，必員員識面，其中有一員得力，則侍","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054923306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"從州郡，莫不刮目。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054923306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":628,"lineType":1,"content":"觀星當以理明推其次苐。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054939690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017722450526246"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":632,"lineType":1,"content":"一看命好星辰俱善柔，亦不能為大事業，又要一凶","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054956074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"星以助其權。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054956074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"大凡吉星多，凶星少，則從吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054972458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":634,"lineType":1,"content":"凶多吉","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054988842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"少，則從凶論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848054988842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":636,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人之命，非權不能以治世。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055005226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"545","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"一、貴人之命，多是䧟弱，有不可觀者。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055021610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":638,"lineType":1,"content":"其中有一星得用，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055037994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"坐煞得時，及官禄有釣起吉星暗加其位者，皆貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055037994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":640,"lineType":1,"content":"不然，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055054378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":642,"lineType":1,"content":"旁有吉星交照官宫，及有吉星照八煞之宫，皆貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055054378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":644,"lineType":1,"content":"一看諸星皆如看命之法，亦看三合及正照，方斷吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055070762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":646,"lineType":1,"content":"凡觀命，先看命宫釣起飛來，次看横衝直撞，吉凶何如。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055087146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017744348856354"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":650,"lineType":1,"content":"若田宅吉，安享父業，終身無灾；官禄吉，僕馬昌盛，榮貴","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055103530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"多財；妻妾吉，倡隨偕老，昆仲和睦。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055103530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":652,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃五福全備之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055119914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"倘此三位值凶星照破，縱富貴亦不能安享。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055136298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":654,"lineType":1,"content":"經云四","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055152682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"直之中，最要相生而為妙，正謂此也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055152682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":656,"lineType":1,"content":"葢官宫與財帛奴","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055169066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":658,"lineType":1,"content":"僕同一局也，田宅與相貎疾厄同一局也，妻妾兄弟福","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055169066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":660,"lineType":1,"content":"徳同一局也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055169066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"562","lineNum":662,"lineType":1,"content":"一看命須是看時令為𦂳，春木、夏火、秋金、冬水，四季","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055185450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":664,"lineType":1,"content":"土星，須看旺相、休囚、死絶為要。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055185450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017722450542630"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"一看得命皆善，日月明㓗，方為吉論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055201834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":668,"lineType":1,"content":"葢天地以日月為","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055218218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"主，若日月明净，方為貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055218218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":670,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：貴人日月要分明，日月","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055234602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":672,"lineType":1,"content":"不明，非貴人也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055234602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":674,"lineType":1,"content":"一論命之法，先起五寅元遁，㸃至命宫，看是何干支，論","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055250986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":676,"lineType":1,"content":"經緯二星要𦂳，再㸃至官禄是何干支，次看天地人元","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055250986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":678,"lineType":1,"content":"禄主，再㸔吉星分布局面，相生相尅何如，又看諸煞方","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055250986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":680,"lineType":1,"content":"布列之仔細詳推，吉凶可判。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055250986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"一論父母妻子，皆用五寅元遁去。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055267370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":682,"lineType":1,"content":"凡命度主起輔在強","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055283754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017722450559014"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"吉之宫，必富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055283754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":686,"lineType":1,"content":"官祿主起輔陽者，必主貴，凡人亦宜近","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055300138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"貴見官。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055300138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":688,"lineType":1,"content":"先生云：凡厯頭諸凶曜，自是人欠審。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055316522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":690,"lineType":1,"content":"一凡諸星入垣尅度者，合大格局必貴，遇限不好，與諸","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055332906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"煞併，此處大凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055332906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"583","lineNum":692,"lineType":1,"content":"凡吉星陷退者，减力一半，煞㑹陰陽者，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055349290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"煞化為吉，不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055349290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"大體只有灾。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055365674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":694,"lineType":1,"content":"火羅計孛，只宜獨行，若交","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055382058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹大凶，隨宫忌之，或相生得用有力，為富不仁。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055382058","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":696,"lineType":1,"content":"對衝三","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055398442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":698,"lineType":1,"content":"方四正，或相遇，主尅父母氣，守命三方對照者必孤，為","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055398442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":700,"lineType":1,"content":"僧為道，相得者吉，尅入者凶，或行限之，必好善出家，遇","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055398442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017744348889122"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":704,"lineType":1,"content":"此，後限如舊。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055398442","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":706,"lineType":9,"content":"論五命","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055414826","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"594","lineNum":706,"lineType":2,"content":"守命附","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"一、看立身立命，何處宫度。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055431210","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":708,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生人看命度主，夜生人看","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055447594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"身度主。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055447594","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":710,"lineType":1,"content":"如上弦望前望後及下弦生者，看命度為𦂳，亦","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055463978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":712,"lineType":1,"content":"如命度之法。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055463978","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"一、立命既定，更看晝生人、夜生人。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055480362","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":714,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生人不要火、金、月、","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055496746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":716,"lineType":1,"content":"孛、羅照命，夜生人不要土、木、日氣照命，名曰五殘星，皆","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055496746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055496746","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":718,"lineType":1,"content":"不然則多憂少樂，生平成敗，碌碌到老。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055513130","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017744348905506"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":722,"lineType":1,"content":"一、晝生人，則要太陽坐夘、辰、巳、午未上方，應朝陽向明","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055529514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"之格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055529514","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":724,"lineType":1,"content":"如晝生而太陽坐申、酉、戌、亥、子、丑之地，皆非合格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055545898","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"609","lineNum":726,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生則要太陰照命，行限亦要火、羅、月、孛當限，方為得","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055562282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":728,"lineType":1,"content":"體。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055562282","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":730,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐祿、坐貴、坐庫，長生駕殿夾貴人祿馬樞，及蔭旺","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055578666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":732,"lineType":1,"content":"斗標卦氣之鄉，皆主富貴，否則亦主衣食豐足。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055578666","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"潭湛囦先生専取貴人祿馬，只取用不同。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055595050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":734,"lineType":1,"content":"故官福星守","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055611434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"命大吉，卦氣印符生旺斗標祿馬，難得𠔥全。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055611434","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":736,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：坐命","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055627818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017796278419466"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":740,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹三星，必主貴顯，難得如此連，鮮有合此格者。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055627818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"619","lineNum":742,"lineType":1,"content":"一命主度、主𧺫坐的殺、刼殺、羊刃，主其人有害父母，骨","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055644202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":744,"lineType":1,"content":"肉不全，出祖破祖，過房自立方免。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055644202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":746,"lineType":1,"content":"一命刼殺、的殺、羊刃、暴敗、空亡、死絶、三煞、飛亷殺者，皆","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055660586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":748,"lineType":1,"content":"主其人性不好，心險行怪，狼暴不仁，衣食勞碌，一事無","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055660586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":750,"lineType":1,"content":"成。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055660586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"624","lineNum":752,"lineType":1,"content":"一、命坐空亡，及主星起坐空，或桃花帶馬者，而又有炁","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055676970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":754,"lineType":1,"content":"孛金水照之，皆主其人慷慨風流，歌唱花月，女人值之，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055676970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017744348938274"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":758,"lineType":1,"content":"决主為娼。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055676970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"628","lineNum":760,"lineType":1,"content":"一十干坐命，且如六甲生人，不要立命在金度上，名曰","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055693354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"鬼尅，皆主勞碌不安，只喜坐在生旺財帛宿之上。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055693354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":762,"lineType":1,"content":"坐水","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055709738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":764,"lineType":1,"content":"度，名曰坐父母之上，土度名曰坐財帛之上，坐火度，名","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055709738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"脱局，當以意𠫵詳，得時得令為好。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055709738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":766,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘十干，當效此推","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055726122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":768,"lineType":1,"content":"之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055726122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"凡守命要生星大妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055742506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":770,"lineType":1,"content":"如癸未八月初一日未時生，斗上","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055758890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":772,"lineType":1,"content":"安命孛守，以五虎遁，從寅上遁起，丑宫得乙孛，是天元","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055758890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017759209177139"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"祿主，大妙。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055758890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"若是殺星専權，終是不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055775274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":776,"lineType":1,"content":"如壬申命，五月二","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055791658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":778,"lineType":1,"content":"十午時生，已上坐命，土守二煞，又是官福二星，木丑火","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055791658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"酉，三方經緯，平生灑落，只是性燥。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055791658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":780,"lineType":1,"content":"計水日在申，四十五","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055808042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":782,"lineType":1,"content":"見水，計暴亡，平生殺數人。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055808042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":784,"lineType":1,"content":"一小兒命，五月二十四子時戍上安命，月守命，金在午，土","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055824426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":786,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅，三方皆是殺，飛亷羊刃，四嵗瘟亡，信乎殺之驗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055824426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"夏仁七官連命，四𧰼俱全格。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055840810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":788,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戌二月夘宫坐命火午","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055857194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"金酉土，子共四千租。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055857194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":790,"lineType":1,"content":"白巖吴玉川丙戌二月子命坐","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055873578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017685280423977"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"女，火土夾羅，計截半天萬石租。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055873578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":794,"lineType":1,"content":"又如六丙六已生人，安","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055889962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":796,"lineType":1,"content":"命在申，丙用金為正魁，木為文魁、官星，已用金為文魁，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055889962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":798,"lineType":1,"content":"木為官魁星。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055889962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"657","lineNum":800,"lineType":1,"content":"如六癸六庚生人，安命在丑，木為文魁，金為官魁，庚用","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055906346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"木為正魁，金為官星。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055906346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":802,"lineType":1,"content":"故詩曰：丙已相逢癸與庚，隂陽磨","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055922730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"竭兩宫亨。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055922730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"官魁金木升晨殿，白屋還應出監𡖖。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055939114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":804,"lineType":1,"content":"正謂此","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055955498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055955498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"　六戌生人安命在午，金為官在酉，火為魁在邜。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055971882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":806,"lineType":1,"content":"六","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055988266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"666","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"已生人命在未，金為魁在辰，火為官在戌。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848055988266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":808,"lineType":1,"content":"六癸生人命","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056004650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017796278452234"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"在已，木為魁在寅，水為官在申。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056004650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"合此最竒。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056021034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":812,"lineType":1,"content":"庚申人安","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056037418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":814,"lineType":1,"content":"命在未，坐玉堂，火為官在午，水為文魁在申，入局拱命。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056037418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":816,"lineType":1,"content":"如已未生人，命坐申，上玉堂，木為官，主在未，金為魁，主","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056053802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"在酉，亦同。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056053802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"如甲辰甲戌生人，用太隂為文魁，忌孛。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056070186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":818,"lineType":1,"content":"癸邜","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056086570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":820,"lineType":1,"content":"癸酉生人，用太隂為正魁，忌火。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056086570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":820,"lineType":2,"content":"盖甲辰甲戌納音屬火，孛尅火，故忌之。癸邜癸","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":822,"lineType":2,"content":"酉納音屬金，火尅金，故忌之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"亥乃此辰垣廟之地，天闗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056102954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":822,"lineType":1,"content":"如六乙生","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056119338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":824,"lineType":1,"content":"人，安命在未，月孛為禄，主守命，太隂入於邜崇勲之宫，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056119338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":826,"lineType":1,"content":"獨亥位無星，此縱漏闗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056119338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017759209193523"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"如太隂在未，命與孛在卯，此横漏闗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056135722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":830,"lineType":1,"content":"生於夜者極清","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056152106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":832,"lineType":1,"content":"貴，若乙已乙亥生人，不取，以其衝破天闗故也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056152106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"688","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"又格身命在未，木在卯，縱漏闗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056168490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":834,"lineType":1,"content":"身命在夘，木在未，横","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056184874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"漏闗也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056184874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"盖亥宫無星，漏一木𧺫来用事，亦是一説。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056201258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"692","lineNum":836,"lineType":1,"content":"此二","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056217642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":838,"lineType":1,"content":"星卯木二宫往来，俱為得地，所為合貴格也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056217642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"694","lineNum":840,"lineType":1,"content":"日從陽，夜從隂，如日生人，寅午戌、申子、辰坐命，以日土","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056234026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":842,"lineType":1,"content":"木水用事；夜生安命已酉、丑、亥、卯、未，以月金火用事，為","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056234026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"福最厚。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056234026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":844,"lineType":1,"content":"若日從隂，夜從陽，則為背，乃隂錯陽差，為福最","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056250410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017685280440361"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"緩。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056250410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":848,"lineType":1,"content":"經曰：三方若背，其人空貴無官。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056266794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"701","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"一安命煞前主後。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056283178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":850,"lineType":1,"content":"如已酉生，安命在子，木為煞星在亥，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056299562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"居命之前；土為命主，居煞之後。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848056299562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":852,"lineType":1,"content":"一前一後，各得其地，遇","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134369343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"者冨貴可知，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134369343","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"706","lineNum":854,"lineType":1,"content":"或命限之主釣起，值煞星居前，不","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134385727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":856,"lineType":1,"content":"能反尅者，不以㐫㫁。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134385727","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"708","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"愚意此説未穏。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134402111","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":858,"lineType":1,"content":"凡已生人，子宫安命者，以木為財福","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134418495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"星，果老，以財福尅命為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134418495","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":860,"lineType":1,"content":"五星經亦云：若還有用不為","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134434879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫，權重凛威風。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134434879","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":862,"lineType":1,"content":"二經皆不以木為忌，此處獨言凶者，恐","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134451263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017746496405540"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"亦未究財福尅命之説歟？","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134451263","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":866,"lineType":1,"content":"聊述鄙見，以候知者。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134467647","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"717","lineNum":868,"lineType":1,"content":"一人命多有生時不定，以子為亥，以亥為子，以初為末，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134484031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"以末為初，則坐度不同，星辰轉動，故曰言禍福不凖。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134484031","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":870,"lineType":1,"content":"須","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134500415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"是加减定其灾祥，受生受尅，方能言其吉凶。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134500415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":872,"lineType":1,"content":"經云：一不","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134516799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"可拘，二須敢斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134516799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":874,"lineType":1,"content":"以禍福不應，未可㨿言休咎必然之理。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134533183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":876,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵村落之人，無譙樓更鼓，又有晦㝠風雨，氣候不齊，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134549567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"難以定時。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134549567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":878,"lineType":1,"content":"又有溺愛而明者，聞人説此時為凶，彼時為","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134565951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，便以吉者為主。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134565951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":880,"lineType":1,"content":"故禍福不應，推命者當意消詳詳之，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134582335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017674794909696"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":884,"lineType":1,"content":"不可以誤傳誤，自壞術法可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134582335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"731","lineNum":886,"lineType":1,"content":"一夾命要曰：月夾命，福祿夾命，官魁夾命，印貴夾命，三","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134598719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"合拱之者亦然，皆主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134598719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"733","lineNum":888,"lineType":1,"content":"或命度主，身度主，起坐别處","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134615103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":890,"lineType":1,"content":"而夾拱之者，但無剥雜，皆是大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134615103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"738","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛一宫，人生受用之大端也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134664255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"739","lineNum":898,"lineType":1,"content":"或福祿照財帛，曰月照","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134680639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017796278468618"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":902,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛，四財互垣，身命二主臨財，及財帛星又逢生旺，得","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134680639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"時得令，皆是有財之人。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134680639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"743","lineNum":904,"lineType":1,"content":"既有財，則可以養妻育子，求功","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134697023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"名，用奴僕。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134697023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":906,"lineType":1,"content":"若財主失經囚耗，暗刑照財，此是無受用之","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134713407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"人。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134713407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"若財帛不好，亦未可遽言其貧。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134729791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":908,"lineType":1,"content":"又㸔田宅宫如何","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134746175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"750","lineNum":912,"lineType":1,"content":"兄弟之宫與福徳妻妾㑹為一局，兄弟之分與吾本","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134778943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"同一氣。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134778943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"果老云：命居閑極，兄弟有争釁之風。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134795327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":914,"lineType":1,"content":"葢人","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134811711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"與兄弟，須是各安其分可也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134811711","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"755","lineNum":916,"lineType":1,"content":"若命入兄弟，我旺則尅","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134828095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017759209259059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"彼，彼怒則仇我，故果老有争興寡之論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134828095","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":920,"lineType":1,"content":"閑星入命者","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134844479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134844479","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"760","lineNum":922,"lineType":1,"content":"惟田財官福入其宫者，主兄弟豪富；空亡、的破","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134860863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":924,"lineType":1,"content":"入此，主兄弟貧賤；孤寡居之，則孤雁獨行；官符居之，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134860863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":926,"lineType":1,"content":"必逞訟；刃雄居之，則帶疾；馬星入，則兄弟東西；咸池入，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134860863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"則酒色迷戀。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134860863","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":928,"lineType":1,"content":"又㸔宫主如何","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134877247","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"766","lineNum":932,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅之位，人生受用之源，或田宅主星不起，或有福徳","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134910015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"767","lineNum":934,"lineType":1,"content":"照臨田宅，日月照身，命主坐田宅，亦作有財帛名望之人，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134910015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017670965428251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":938,"lineType":1,"content":"既有田宅，則妻子功名皆自此出。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134910015","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":938,"lineType":1,"content":"又一婦人田宅宫，如","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134926399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":940,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚暗耗坐其宫者，并有要殺在上，皆主破敗，外家冷","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134926399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"落，兄弟無情。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134926399","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵婦人最重田宅財帛。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134942783","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":942,"lineType":1,"content":"二宫","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134959167","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"776","lineNum":946,"lineType":1,"content":"水宫一數，火宫二數，木三、金四、土五，加吉星則足其數，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134991935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"加㐫星刑尅者必孤，三方對衝稍輕。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848134991935","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":948,"lineType":1,"content":"若本宫及三方對","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135008319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":950,"lineType":1,"content":"宫相得者皆吉，或尅或不尅，皆隨星論之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135008319","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"780","lineNum":952,"lineType":1,"content":"一、男女宫坐禄馬、貴人、長生及有吉星照者，皆主得貴子","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135024703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017796278517770"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":956,"lineType":1,"content":"及孝順賢能之子，更加有吉星三方對照者，子宫必好。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135024703","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"783","lineNum":958,"lineType":1,"content":"如子坐劒殺、的殺、死絶之宫，及無吉星照者，皆不得好","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135041087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"子，併作無子斷。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135041087","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":960,"lineType":1,"content":"　一、男女宫有羅計、孛火、刑囚、暗耗者，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135057471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"皆主其人多子。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135057471","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":962,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人一年一産及老皆不得力，如鷄抱","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135073855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"鴨相似。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135073855","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"不然忤逆之男多出在外，雖有若無。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135090239","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"790","lineNum":964,"lineType":1,"content":"　一、夜生","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135106623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽獨照男女宫，而無星以輔之者，主無子。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135106623","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":966,"lineType":1,"content":"晝生而見","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135123007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":968,"lineType":1,"content":"獨月亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135123007","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":968,"lineType":1,"content":"惟有夜生水輔日在男女宫者，反主有子，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135139391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"以其孤陽不生，孤隂不成，故有此論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135139391","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":970,"lineType":1,"content":"又㸔其主星要𦂳，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135155775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017759209242675"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":974,"lineType":1,"content":"只喜恩生男女，主在强宫實地，自然有子，若有殺害空","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135155775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"亡，則减半力。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135155775","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":976,"lineType":1,"content":"假如日生人，太陰守男女宫，男女主又飛起","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135172159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"在弱宫，或化直難星，或落空亡，多主無子。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135172159","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":978,"lineType":1,"content":"夜生人，太陰","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135188543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"守之，又看其男女星飛在强弱宫，分輕重論。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135188543","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":980,"lineType":1,"content":"如主星飛在","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135204927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"强實之位，則主損頭胎，終還有子，先女後生男之類。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135204927","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":982,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135221311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"主星有落空强之地，則主多生多尅。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135221311","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":984,"lineType":1,"content":"如白虎、六害、華盖","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135237695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"809","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"臨之流年旬中又空，則可知其必無子也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135237695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":986,"lineType":1,"content":"如男子主星","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135254079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":988,"lineType":1,"content":"及男女宫暫為流旬所空，則只此十年無子，過旬又計","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135254079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017746496438308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"813","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"生子，不可執一。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135254079","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":992,"lineType":1,"content":"如男女主是我命之煞，守陽刄煞、六害、","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135270463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕、白虎之宫，則多生不肖之子。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135270463","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":994,"lineType":1,"content":"如主星守天月二徳貴人，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135286847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":996,"lineType":1,"content":"及諸强宫與㤙星守，則帛或男女主為㤙星者，多生徳力賢","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135286847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":998,"lineType":1,"content":"貴之子而無疑矣。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135286847","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":998,"lineType":1,"content":"男女數見首條，如星坐實强宫，各添一數。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135303231","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"821","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"一身坐奴僕有吉有㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135335999","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":1002,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人之格多是身𡿨主，入奴僕","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135352383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"而貴者，亦有入奴僕而賤者。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135352383","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":1004,"lineType":1,"content":"如奴僕宫主原是六馬貴","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135368767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":1006,"lineType":1,"content":"人、長生帝旺、駕殿祿勲之地，皆不可以奴僕論，皆為國","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135368767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017759737724968"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"出力大貴之命。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135368767","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":1010,"lineType":1,"content":"如奴僕宫，原是的殺、羊刄、亡神、飛亷、死","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135385151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":1012,"lineType":1,"content":"絶、暴敗之鄉，而身命主又陷其上，此是奔走服役，奔波","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135385151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"830","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"無成之人，方以奴僕言之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135385151","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":1014,"lineType":1,"content":"一奴僕不獨轄人貴賤勞𨓜，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135401535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"亦主僕馬侍從。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135401535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":1016,"lineType":1,"content":"本星坐於強旺之地，更加吉星出之，必","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135417919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"主僕馬豐盛。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135417919","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"若主星弱，奴星強，反被奴僕欺害。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135434303","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"836","lineNum":1018,"lineType":1,"content":"果老云：","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135450687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":1020,"lineType":1,"content":"主弱奴強，奴僕有侵凌之患，大扺以身命髙強為上也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135450687","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"839","lineNum":1024,"lineType":1,"content":"一妻宫是禄貴、長生、帝旺之地，皆主好妻，及羙貌多能。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135483455","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017786623148032"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":1028,"lineType":1,"content":"如妻宫是死絶、的殺、刼殺、暴敗，皆不得好妻，更㑹孤寡","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135499839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"惡宿，必主無妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135499839","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"術家所云鼓盆星五行絶位是也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135516223","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":1030,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹䘮","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135532607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"弔二符、計都，必尅妻。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135532607","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":1032,"lineType":1,"content":"如妻星是殺星，坐強坐實，或殿駕，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135548991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":1034,"lineType":1,"content":"或守田宅，守財帛者，主妻多做大規模，欺凌夫主也。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135548991","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":1036,"lineType":1,"content":"古人以日為夫妻，但年月日時多一干者，為犯重婚，故","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135565375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":1038,"lineType":1,"content":"有兩甲兩妻之説。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135565375","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"850","lineNum":1038,"lineType":1,"content":"五星專以妻妾宫主星，㸔其空實、弱","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135581759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"強生尅之理以明之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135581759","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"如是。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135598143","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":1040,"lineType":1,"content":"第宫主落空，亡居弱地，有的","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135614527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":1042,"lineType":1,"content":"殺、六害、白虎加其宫分，及臨其主所守之地者，必多尅","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135614527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7351017725206102079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"856","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"害。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135614527","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"如妻星化直，難坐咸池、的殺同宫，必多産厄而亡。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135630911","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":1046,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135647295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":1048,"lineType":1,"content":"妻星是太隂坐未，或在午，或入兄弟宫，多主因親致親，","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135647295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":1050,"lineType":1,"content":"或姨兄弟為之。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135647295","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":1050,"lineType":1,"content":"或妻星单坐華盖及陽刄我命宫坐白","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135663679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"虎者，則多與妻不和隔角之𩔖。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135663679","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"863","lineNum":1052,"lineType":1,"content":"如妻星落陷，若得餘氣","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135680063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"有力，必有小妻偕老。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135680063","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":1054,"lineType":1,"content":"　又如妻星坐咸池，與兄弟主、奴","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135696447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":1056,"lineType":1,"content":"僕主同宫，又有的殺、驛馬夾之者，則主其妻與外人及","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135696447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":1058,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕通情者，極驗，不可不信。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135696447","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"868","lineNum":1058,"lineType":1,"content":"婦人尅夫，亦以兄弟宫","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135712831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":1060,"lineType":1,"content":"主星依次條㫁之，萬不失一。","logicSentenceId":"7679033848135712831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
